create_SELayer: create a Squeeze-and-Excitation attention layer for MinkowskiEngine sparse tensors with configurable channel reduction
build_SEBasicBlock: build an SE-enhanced basic ResNet block with two conv layers and channel-wise attention for sparse 3D data
create_SEBasicBlockSN: create an SE basic block variant using sparse switch normalization for MinkowskiEngine sparse convolutions

create_SEBottleneckLN: create an SE bottleneck block variant using sparse layer normalization for MinkowskiEngine sparse convolutions
